title: Online maximal independent set
subtitle: Arrival-order greedy maintains maximality after every prefix without revisions.

panels.title: Maximality after every prefix
panels.note: Vertex arrivals reveal earlier neighbors; all previous accept/reject decisions stay fixed.

verifiedRecords.output: Consistent maximal independent set after every prefix
verifiedRecords.notes: Accept a vertex iff it has no accepted neighbor. Rejected vertices retain an accepted witness; later arrivals cannot destroy maximality. This is a derived online consequence, not a competitive maximum-size theorem.

axisNote: Zero-recourse feasibility for maximal independent set. Maximum-cardinality competition is in the separate Maximum independent set row.
coverageNote: Bounded primary-source review completed 27 October 2026. Results are scoped comparisons, not an exhaustive or best-known-frontier claim.
lowerBoundStatus: No lower bound for maintaining maximality was verified here. Competitive-size obstructions concern a different objective.
